request.title: Chronos, the Timekeeper
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: Chronos, god of time, fate and destiny: whimsical, detached but wise. An ancient, long-bearded timekeeper sits cross-legged and relaxed on top of a giant floating hourglass, among drifting clock faces, gears and a tall grandfather clock hanging in the air. Below him, a battle is frozen mid-moment in a bubble of stopped time. He is not watching it: he looks off to the side with a faint, amused, knowing smile, turning a small pocket watch in his fingers. Dominant gold and deep blue palette.

references.role: Appearance reference for Chronos only: the figure of the old wizard holding the hourglass (centre right) in this group painting of the six gods. Keep that figure's look, colours and costume; ignore the other gods, the title lettering and the composition.
Reference for the grandfather clock and the bubble of frozen time only. Ignore the man.

request.alt: Chronos, an ancient bearded timekeeper sitting on a floating hourglass among clocks, smiling at nothing while a battle is frozen below.
